workLog.phase: Extend the patterns and prove they are load-bearing
actions: Added two patterns scoped to the second segment, templates/agents/ and templates/platforms/, rather than a bare templates/ prefix

Chose the narrow scope because bare templates/ also names a Flask or Django render directory, a file-relative asset directory bundled inside a skill, and a substring of unrelated URLs, and all three resolve consumer-side
Extended the lookbehind character class with a hyphen so a URL segment like awesome-templates/agents/ does not match
Ran a ten-case table over the compiled patterns covering both new families, Windows separators, mixed case, and five negatives; all ten matched expectation
Negative control on the real validator: removed the marker from negotiation/SKILL.md and confirmed the validator reports DRIFT, then restored it and confirmed a clean run
workLog.outcome: Patterns verified to fire on the true positives and stay silent on the four negative shapes

actions: Added a vendor-portability marker to autoplan, negotiation, and security-review rather than deleting their references
Chose declaration over deletion because all three cite templates/ for provenance, which .claude/rules/canonical-source-mirror.md requires them to do
Regenerated the Copilot mirror with build/scripts/build_all.py and confirmed the marker survived generation in all three mirrored files
Bumped .claude and src/copilot-cli manifests to 0.6.133, above main's 0.6.131 and above the 0.6.132 claimed by open PR #3448
workLog.outcome: Validator stays at baseline 0 with the wider patterns in force, so the ratchet tightens without grandfathering anything

actions: Confirmed the reviewer's BLOCKER by probe rather than by reading: the new lookbehind (?<![\\\w.-]) omitted the forward slash, so src/templates/agents/x.md, assets/templates/agents/x.md and https://example.com/templates/agents/x.md each counted as an upstream reference. Trailing ? and # were also unhandled, so templates/agents?raw=1 and templates/agents#section counted as zero. POSIX and Windows disagreed on the nested form.

Replaced both patterns with (?<![\\/\w.-])(?:\.[\\/]+)?templates[\\/]+(agents|platforms)(?:[\\/]+|['\"?#]|$). The optional dot-separator group preserves ./templates/agents/ once the separator joins the lookbehind. Verified against 23 shapes, all correct.

Replaced test_does_not_count_templates_nested_under_another_dir, which used assets/templates/foo.md. That string lacks the required second segment, so it could never match any pattern and passed against the defective regex. Added 22 parametrized cases covering every probe shape.

Narrowed the vendor-portability markers from three files to one. A marker suppresses every pattern for the whole file, so marking autoplan and negotiation also exempted them from the .agents/, .claude/lib/ and .claude/review-axes/ patterns, weakening the ratchet rather than tightening it.

Reworded the two references instead. negotiation/SKILL.md pointed a plugin consumer at templates/agents/negotiation.shared.md, a file they never receive; the instruction it supported was complete without the pointer. autoplan/SKILL.md used the path as an illustrative tier signal, not as provenance. Only security-review declares canonical_source in frontmatter and genuinely mirrors upstream content, so only it keeps a marker.
Corrected startingCommit from 0e23a56a40 to 98caa0e54d, the actual parent of the branch's first commit 92df2118e2.
Corrected the markdownLintRun evidence, which claimed three SKILL.md files were linted. Both .claude/skills/** and src/copilot-cli/skills/** are excluded by .markdownlint-cli2.yaml.

Bumped both manifests to 0.6.135. Main advanced to 0.6.133 while this PR was open, so the claimed 0.6.133 would have shipped fourteen changed plugin files under an unchanged version. The gate passed regardless because it resolves the merge-base, not the tip.
workLog.outcome: Regex verified through the validator itself, not only in isolation: templates/agents/x.md, ./templates/platforms/y.yaml and a bare templates/agents each fail it, while src/templates/agents/x.md and an https:// URL containing the same segments do not. 55 tests pass, ruff clean, ratchet reports zero refs across zero files.
